description: Search Aleksei Aleinikov engineering articles (EN/DE) on Google Cloud, Kubernetes/GKE, Cloud Security, Architecture, PostgreSQL, AI/LLM, and Hardware Lab. Use this first to discover articles and obtain valid pillar and slug values before calling read_article; use get_candidate_profile instead for CV/hiring questions, or list_tools for interactive browser utilities. Read-only, unauthenticated, no side effects, uses a 10-minute cached search index, and is subject to a 30 req/min per-IP rate limit. Returns matching article metadata and URLs, or an empty list message when nothing matches.

lang.description: Optional language index ("en" or "de"). Auto-detected from query keywords and German umlauts if omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked results to return (1-15, default 5).

query.description: Non-empty search keywords or topic phrase.

name: search_articles
